genius_advantages.point: Heavy C-suite churn in 18 months (see below)

competitor_advantages.point: **Jack in the Box** (2,128 locations) chose R365 as sole back-office inventory platform (Mar 5, 2026); R365 already did accounting for ~half the system — "Restaurant365 delivers unified, real-time visibility into sales, food costs, and labor" (Doug Cook, CTO)

latest_cos_commentary.headline: Accounting plus inventory integration is a sticky Genius Back Office rival at Jack in the Box.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Accounting plus inventory integration is a sticky Genius Back Office rival at Jack in the Box.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Jack in the Box chose R365 as sole back-office inventory platform in March 2026; rollout scope must be verified separately. Second check: Hungry Howie’s selected Restaurant365 for systemwide back-office operations in June 2026.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Map accounting/inventory data ownership, franchisee contracting and deployment stage before positioning replacement.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Selection as sole platform does not establish systemwide live adoption or vendor financial performance. Selection and future standardization are not equivalent to a completed franchise rollout.

vendor_claims.value: Restaurant365 currently markets a restaurant-management suite spanning accounting, inventory, scheduling, payroll and R365 AI.
vendor_claims.limitations_or_conflicts: Advertised efficiency and cost-saving percentages were not independently validated and are not classified as strengths.

vendor_claims.value: Restaurant365 maintains an API layer for third-party services to exchange data with the platform.
vendor_claims.limitations_or_conflicts: Endpoint breadth and read/write restrictions were not exhaustively inventoried.

vendor_claims.value: Restaurant365 documents near-real-time OData transaction access but states that sales and labor data become available only after Daily Sales Summary polling.
vendor_claims.limitations_or_conflicts: Actual polling cadence and therefore end-to-end latency are deployment-dependent.

vendor_claims.value: Restaurant365 markets a restaurant-specific employee-training platform for standardized learning and compliance.
vendor_claims.limitations_or_conflicts: Independent training outcome evidence and ExpandShare acquisition lineage were not validated in the opened corpus.

product_lineage.value: Restaurant365 acquired Compeat in June 2021; Restaurant365 described Compeat as restaurant back-office, workforce and business-intelligence software.
product_lineage.limitations_or_conflicts: Current migration/support status of individual Compeat modules remains unclear.

product_lineage.value: A Ctuit RADAR web endpoint remained reachable during the 2026-09-29 research cycle.
product_lineage.limitations_or_conflicts: Reachable login endpoint does not establish active sales, support horizon or customer count.

weaknesses.value: A two-location restaurant operator publicly questioned the value of a quoted Restaurant365 annual cost of $10,876.32.
weaknesses.limitations_or_conflicts: One quote only; bundle, negotiation and contract terms are unknown and the amount is not a list-price benchmark.
